description.name: Basic Attack: Leap
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to four attacks ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
If the Basic Attack hits the target, gain <Term:1000032></Term> after the skill ends.
After the 4th hit of the Basic Attack ends, 1 <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> is applied to enemies hit.

description.name: Basic Attack: Solo Dance
description.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform a slash in an area ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
If it hits a target, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> after the skill ends.

description.name: Basic Attack: Rainbow's End
description.desc:
When Remielle has <Term:1000033></Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleash a powerful large area attack ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Grants a large amount of <color=#FFFFFF>[Floating Radiance]</color> when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the <Term:1000034></Term> effect after the skill ends with a <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:100+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*5,1,2}%</color> multiplier.
Consumes all stored <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> upon use.

description.name: Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace
description.desc:
When Remielle has stored <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> and is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleash a powerful large area attack ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Grants a large amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminize</color> effect after the skill ends with a multiplier of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:200+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*10,1,2}%</color>.
Consumes all stored <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> upon use.

description.name: Dodge: Retreating Light
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Keen Light
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a quick attack ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Mirrored Shadow
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleash a powerful slash at the target, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Sliver of Light
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launch a ranged attack ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
Chain Attack: Interwoven Dance Steps
description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state upon activation. The next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>.
After the skill ends, apply 2 <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch a attack across a large area in front, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
If the skill hits, the <Term:1000034></Term> effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:210+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*10.5,1,2}%</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist: Featherglow Rebirth
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a slash at the target, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Fleeting Light
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Awakening Glimmer
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes against the target, dealing <color=#FF5521>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist: Flower & Feather Dance
description.desc:
Enter the battlefield and unleash an attack in a large area, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Consumes 40 <Term:1000032></Term> upon activation. With 90 or fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> remaining upon activation, this <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> does not consume <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color>. The character also enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>.
When this skill hits a Stunned enemy, its Stun duration is extended by 3s. Each enemy can be affected by this effect only once per Stun. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with other effects of the same type.
If the skill hits, the <Term:1000034></Term> effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:200+AvatarSkillLevel(6)*10,1,2}%</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1581004.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Normal> (Hold with Voidflare while in the Luminous Reflection state)

1581007.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Special> (Hold with max Floating Radiance) or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> (Hold with max Floating Radiance)

1581012.desc: <IconMap:Icon_Switch> (After triggering 3 Refringe reactions while in the Phase Flow state)

name: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors
Additional Ability: Invitation to Bloom
desc:
Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringe Coefficient]</color> is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly]</color> characters in the squad, her <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringe Coefficient]</color> increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a <Term:1000031></Term> reaction via a squad member, she generates <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> based on the <Term:1000023></Term> after it has been enhanced by <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringe]</color> for this Attribute Anomaly effect. Up to the 3 most recently generated <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> can be stored.
If <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist: Flower & Feather Dance]</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call]</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Rainbow's End]</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace]</color> hits a target, <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> is triggered after the skill ends:
Based on the total <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly Effect Strength]</color> of all stored <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color>, this deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by <color=#2BAD00>0.1%</color> of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.
All stored <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> are cleared when Remielle enters the <Term:1000035></Term> state or after using <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Rainbow's End]</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace]</color>.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly]</color> character or shares the same faction:
When there are 1/2/3 <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly]</color> characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,600 ATK. Additionally, while in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, Remielle's Daze dealt increases by 6%/12%/35%.
When Remielle applies <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumiflux Buildup]</color> to an enemy, they also inflict <color=#FFFFFF>[Prismatic]</color>: When all squad members attack an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>[Prismatic]</color>, Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 15%. <color=#FFFFFF>[Prismatic]</color> is removed when the enemy no longer has <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumiflux Buildup]</color>. After <color=#FFFFFF>[Prismatic]</color> is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.

1.name: Naive Oath
1.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special <Term:1000033></Term>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers <Term:1000034></Term> to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist: Flower & Feather Dance]</color>, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.

2.name: Fall Into the Noise
2.desc: Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringe Coefficient]</color> increases by 20%. When an <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly]</color> character in the squad deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>[Prismatic]</color>, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after <color=#FFFFFF>[Prismatic]</color> ends. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, the frequency at which she automatically launches attacks to apply <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumiflux Buildup]</color> to enemies increases.

4.name: The Long Goodbye
4.desc: When Remielle triggers <Term:1000034></Term>, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%. After Remielle enters the battlefield and gains 3 special <Term:1000033></Term>, if all <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> again. This effect is removed after triggering once or when Remielle enters the <Term:1000035></Term> state.

6.name: Lone Feather's Endless Flight
6.desc: When Remielle uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Rainbow's End]</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace]</color>, <Term:1000034></Term> is triggered twice. If the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> lands, Remielle gains 3 special <Term:1000033></Term> after the move ends. Special <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special <color=#FFFFFF>[Voidflare]</color> gained upon entering the battlefield.
